title: Hermes on a model of your own
description: Hermes Agent with a model on your own server (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM or another OpenAI-compatible one) and nothing else: only the server's address is opened, the loop guard is on, and Hermes' own loop guardrails and turn limit follow it.

de.title: Hermes mit einem eigenen Modell
de.description: Hermes Agent mit einem Modell auf Ihrem eigenen Server (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM oder ein anderer OpenAI-kompatibler) und sonst nichts: nur die Adresse des Servers ist offen, der Schleifenschutz ist an, und Hermes' eigene Schleifenbremsen und Rundengrenze folgen ihm.

llm.label: LLM server (sandbox-ai llm list), NAME or NAME:MODEL
llm.hint: sandbox-ai llm add ollama --kind ollama --url http://127.0.0.1:11434 --model MODEL

notes: Register the server once: sandbox-ai llm add NAME --kind ollama|lmstudio|llamacpp|vllm|openai-compatible --url URL --model MODEL; sandbox-ai llm check NAME --agent hermes asks it for the Chat Completions API Hermes uses.

Hermes gets the server in its managed configuration (/etc/hermes/config.yaml): the URL, the model, its context window when the server reports one, and the key as a placeholder the connection proxy replaces. The loop guard's layers become Hermes' own switches: tool_loop_guardrails with a hard stop, agent.max_turns, compression, and the guard's instructions as a skill loaded in every session.
Agents need a model with tool calls and a long context (qwen3-coder, gpt-oss, ...; Ollama: OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=32768 or more). On this host's loopback (http://127.0.0.1:PORT) only with Podman.
Its image first: sandbox-ai build hermes.
